name: Karl Barth
likelyAffirmations: God is known because God speaks
Jesus Christ is the decisive center of theology
human systems must be judged by revelation
likelyConcerns: religion replacing encounter with the living God
discernmentQuestions: How is Jesus Christ central to this claim?
Is this grounded in God's self-revelation or in projection?
What human system might be trying to control the Word?
pastoralWarnings: Do not let systems speak louder than Christ.
Do not confuse religious energy with obedience to the Word.
Challenge ideology without losing pastoral patience.
